Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Marshall for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events, 1 of them free. The magic runs from the Winter Festival and Trail of Lights at Piney Park (November 13) through December 31, with Wonderland of Lights in downtown Marshall (November 25 to December 30), the Lighted Christmas Parade (December 5) and The Snowman with Marshall Kids Community Theater (December 16) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website or an official calendar, and each listing links straight there.
